jsons/levels/sapfling6.json#/objects/1/o.en: Zombies are CHARGING towards our Sapflings!
jsons/levels/sapfling6.json#/objects/1/o.zh: 僵尸正在全速冲向我们的树脂投手！
jsons/levels/sapfling6.json#/objects/1/o.ru: Зомби НЕСУТСЯ прямо к нашим Смоломётам!

jsons/levels/sapfling6.json#/objects/1/o.en: Worry not, User Dave. We have 2 solution for this:
jsons/levels/sapfling6.json#/objects/1/o.zh: 别担心，用户戴夫。我们有2种解决方案：
jsons/levels/sapfling6.json#/objects/1/o.ru: Не волнуйтесь, Пользователь Дейв. У нас есть два решения.

jsons/levels/sapfling6.json#/objects/1/o.en: 1. Slow those zombies down by applying multiple kinds of debuffs
jsons/levels/sapfling6.json#/objects/1/o.zh: 1. 使用多种减速手段使僵尸寸步难行
jsons/levels/sapfling6.json#/objects/1/o.ru: 1. Замедлить зомби, сочетая разные ослабляющие эффекты.

jsons/levels/sapfling6.json#/objects/1/o.en: 2. Apply heavy firepower and kill the zombies before they could reach our Sapflings
jsons/levels/sapfling6.json#/objects/1/o.zh: 2. 使用重火力压制，在僵尸撞到树脂投手前将其击杀
jsons/levels/sapfling6.json#/objects/1/o.ru: 2. Обрушить на зомби мощный огонь и уничтожить их раньше, чем они доберутся до Смоломётов.

jsons/levels/sapfling6.json#/objects/1/o.en: Why don't we do both at the same time?
jsons/levels/sapfling6.json#/objects/1/o.zh: 要不咱们两招一起上呗？
jsons/levels/sapfling6.json#/objects/1/o.ru: А почему бы не сделать и то и другое?

jsons/levels/sapfling6.json#/objects/2/o.en: Slow zombies down and deal heavy damage!
jsons/levels/sapfling6.json#/objects/2/o.zh: 减速僵尸并造成巨额伤害！
jsons/levels/sapfling6.json#/objects/2/o.ru: Замедляйте зомби и наносите огромный урон!

jsons/objects/NarrativeList.json#/object.en: These monks are really amazing!
jsons/objects/NarrativeList.json#/object.zh: 这些武僧真是厉害！
jsons/objects/NarrativeList.json#/object.ru: Эти монахи и правда хороши!

jsons/objects/NarrativeList.json#/object.en: More torches and nunchucks! We still can't get powerful plant partners from this time-space turbulence.
jsons/objects/NarrativeList.json#/object.zh: 又是火棍和双节棍！我们还没办法从这时空乱流中拿到强力的植物伙伴！
jsons/objects/NarrativeList.json#/object.ru: Опять факелы и нунчаки! А из этой пространственно-временной кутерьмы нам всё ещё не удаётся вытащить сильных растительных союзников.

jsons/objects/NarrativeList.json#/object.en: Don't be discouraged, User Dave — where there's a will, there's a way!
jsons/objects/NarrativeList.json#/object.zh: 不要沮丧，用户戴夫，天无绝人之路！
jsons/objects/NarrativeList.json#/object.ru: Не унывайте, Пользователь Дейв. Было бы желание, а выход найдётся!

jsons/objects/NarrativeList.json#/object.en: Monks aren't good at holding their breath, and Tanglekelps can entangle them in the water cubes of Aqua Vines!
jsons/objects/NarrativeList.json#/object.zh: 武僧们并不擅长憋气，水草可以把他们缠入水生藤蔓的水立方里。
jsons/objects/NarrativeList.json#/object.ru: Монахи плохо задерживают дыхание, а Спутывающие водоросли могут затянуть их в водяные кубы Водных лоз!

jsons/objects/NarrativeList.json#/object.en: This way, we can make them lose their fighting ability!!
jsons/objects/NarrativeList.json#/object.zh: 这样就可以让他们丧失战斗能力啦！
jsons/objects/NarrativeList.json#/object.ru: Так мы лишим их возможности сражаться!

jsons/objects/NarrativeList.json#/object.en: Let those nunchucku-wielding monks who just stepped onto the field taste some 'watery' jelly!
jsons/objects/NarrativeList.json#/object.zh: 让那些刚踏入场地的双截棍武僧们尝尝水果冻的滋味吧！
jsons/objects/NarrativeList.json#/object.ru: Пусть монахи с нунчаками, едва ступив на лужайку, попробуют наше водяное желе!

jsons/objects/NarrativeList.json#/object.en: Well, a Watery Grave of sorts.
jsons/objects/NarrativeList.json#/object.zh: 好吧，看来是某种意义上的水上坟墓。
jsons/objects/NarrativeList.json#/object.ru: Что ж, своего рода водяная могила.

jsons/objects/NarrativeList.json#/object.en: Penny, some of my old pals want to assist in this battle, but several can't be planted on Lily Pads due to their deep roots.
jsons/objects/NarrativeList.json#/object.zh: 潘妮，我的一些老伙计想协助这场战斗，但他们中的一些深根扎入地底不能被种植在莲叶上。
jsons/objects/NarrativeList.json#/object.ru: Пенни, старые приятели хотят помочь в этой битве, но некоторых не посадишь на Кувшинки из-за их глубоких корней.

jsons/objects/NarrativeList.json#/object.en: Don't worry. This is no longer a problem, User Dave.
jsons/objects/NarrativeList.json#/object.zh: 别为此担心，用户戴夫。
jsons/objects/NarrativeList.json#/object.ru: Не беспокойтесь, Пользователь Дейв. Теперь это решаемо.

jsons/objects/NarrativeList.json#/object.en: We know that plants with deep roots like Resistant Radishes cannot be planted on Lily Pads.
jsons/objects/NarrativeList.json#/object.zh: 我们知道，像白萝卜这样的深根植物不能被种植在莲叶上。
jsons/objects/NarrativeList.json#/object.ru: Растения с глубокими корнями, например Стойкую редьку, нельзя сажать на Кувшинки.

jsons/objects/NarrativeList.json#/object.en: But Aqua Vines enable them to join in aquatic battle.
jsons/objects/NarrativeList.json#/object.zh: 但水生藤蔓可以使他们也能参与水上作战。
jsons/objects/NarrativeList.json#/object.ru: Но Водные лозы позволяют им участвовать и в сражениях на воде.

jsons/objects/NarrativeList.json#/object.en: The same rule applies to our comrade!
jsons/objects/NarrativeList.json#/object.zh: 对我们的老战友同样适用的规则！
jsons/objects/NarrativeList.json#/object.ru: Это относится и к нашему боевому товарищу!

jsons/objects/NarrativeList.json#/object.en: Aqua Vine's Plant Food effect can push zombies back to the baseline.
jsons/objects/NarrativeList.json#/object.zh: 水生藤蔓发动叶绿素效果可以把僵尸推至底线。
jsons/objects/NarrativeList.json#/object.ru: Усиление Водной лозы отбрасывает зомби к дальнему краю лужайки.

jsons/objects/NarrativeList.json#/object.en: Those annoying imps always piss me off!
jsons/objects/NarrativeList.json#/object.zh: 这些小鬼可真够烦人的！
jsons/objects/NarrativeList.json#/object.ru: Эти надоедливые чертенята вечно выводят меня из себя!

jsons/objects/NarrativeList.json#/object.en: They'd ruin everything you appreciate! Especially when there's a whole horde of them!
jsons/objects/NarrativeList.json#/object.zh: 他们会吃掉你珍视的一切！尤其是当他们数量多起来后！
jsons/objects/NarrativeList.json#/object.ru: Они сгрызут всё, чем дорожишь! Особенно когда их набегает целая орда!

jsons/objects/NarrativeList.json#/object.en: That is indeed a common concern, User Dave...
jsons/objects/NarrativeList.json#/object.zh: 这样的顾虑的确很常见，用户戴夫……
jsons/objects/NarrativeList.json#/object.ru: Это и правда знакомая проблема, Пользователь Дейв…

jsons/objects/NarrativeList.json#/object.en: I would personally suggest *PLANTING GUACODILES* in those Aqua Vines to eliminate some of the imps!
jsons/objects/NarrativeList.json#/object.zh: 我建议「在水藤里种植鳄梨」以消灭这些恼人的小鬼僵尸
jsons/objects/NarrativeList.json#/object.ru: Я бы посоветовала *САЖАТЬ ГУАКОДИЛОВ* в Водные лозы, чтобы расправиться с частью чертенят!

jsons/objects/NarrativeList.json#/object.en: *PLANT GUACODILES* in those endangered Aqua Vines to eliminate some of the imps!
jsons/objects/NarrativeList.json#/object.zh: 「在水藤里种植鳄梨」以消灭这些恼人的小鬼僵尸！
jsons/objects/NarrativeList.json#/object.ru: *САЖАЙТЕ ГУАКОДИЛОВ* в Водные лозы под угрозой, чтобы расправиться с частью чертенят!

jsons/objects/NarrativeList.json#/object.en: Lotorpedoes in water can deal with Parasol Zombies, while on land they can handle Excavator Zombies.
jsons/objects/NarrativeList.json#/object.zh: 鱼雷莲蓬在水中可以对付阳伞僵尸，在陆地上可以解决发掘者僵尸。
jsons/objects/NarrativeList.json#/object.ru: В воде Лототорпеды справятся с зомби с зонтиками, а на суше — с зомби-землекопами.

jsons/objects/NarrativeList.json#/object.en: Notice: There is a limited supply of Aquatic Vines.
jsons/objects/NarrativeList.json#/object.zh: 注意：水生藤蔓的数量有限。
jsons/objects/NarrativeList.json#/object.ru: Внимание! Запас Водных лоз ограничен.

jsons/objects/NarrativeList.json#/object.en: You can't cover everything — so take care of the most critical one first.
jsons/objects/NarrativeList.json#/object.zh: 你不可能什么都顾得上——那就先顾最要紧的那个。
jsons/objects/NarrativeList.json#/object.ru: За всем не уследишь. Сначала позаботьтесь о самом важном.

jsons/objects/NarrativeList.json#/object.en: The information shows that there is an extreme shortage of water resources here.
jsons/objects/NarrativeList.json#/object.zh: 信息显示这里极度缺乏水资源。
jsons/objects/NarrativeList.json#/object.ru: По имеющимся данным, воды здесь крайне мало.

jsons/objects/NarrativeList.json#/object.en: Without water, our plants can't reach their full potential!
jsons/objects/NarrativeList.json#/object.zh: 没有水，我们的植物无法发挥全部的实力了！
jsons/objects/NarrativeList.json#/object.ru: Без воды наши растения не смогут показать всё, на что способны!

jsons/objects/NarrativeList.json#/object.en: Don't worry.
jsons/objects/NarrativeList.json#/object.zh: 不用担心。
jsons/objects/NarrativeList.json#/object.ru: Не беспокойтесь.

jsons/objects/NarrativeList.json#/object.en: If there's no water, we'll create water!
jsons/objects/NarrativeList.json#/object.zh: 没有水，我们就创造水！
jsons/objects/NarrativeList.json#/object.ru: Если воды нет, мы её создадим!

jsons/levels/aquavine4.json#/objects/1/o.en: You cannot plant plants on moltenpool
jsons/levels/aquavine4.json#/objects/1/o.zh: 无法在 熔岩池 上种植植物
jsons/levels/aquavine4.json#/objects/1/o.ru: Нельзя сажать растения на лавовых озёрах
